verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's NIW page describes a flat attorney fee for the I-140 and says government filing fees are handled separately. It also states payment terms ($500/month over 14 months, or a 10% pay-in-full discount) and says RFE responses cost nothing extra. Its premium-processing material covers only what premium processing speeds up, not how that fee is priced or separated. missing for 10: an itemized pricing page showing the attorney fee amount alongside the actual USCIS filing and premium processing fee amounts, an all-in cost total, and independent corroboration of fee honesty.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's pricing pages separate its own fees from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, so the all-in cost is honest

citations.quote: A flat attorney fee for the I-140 petition. Adjustment of Status and government filing fees are handled separately.
pay in full (10% discount available) or spread over 14 months at $500/month
